newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN RAPESEED HARVEST SHOWING HIGH YIELDS - ZMP.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN RAPESEED HARVEST SHOWING HIGH YIELDS - ZMP.

text.p: Winter rapeseed harvesting in Germany is in full swing, showing higher yields and qualities than last year, the farm price office ZMP said in a weekly report.
Oil contents were at above 40 percent.

Initial yield indications, where available, were as follows -- Schleswig-Holstein at least 4.00 tonnes per hectare (tph), Lower Saxony 3.00 tph, Mecklenburg 2.5-4.00 tph, Saxony 3.0-3.5 tph, Baden-Wuerttemberg 3.5-4.0 tph.
Thuringia reported some problems with plant diseases and pests.
Last year's national average yield of 2.28 tph was sharply down from 3.19 tph in 1995 due to winter damage.
Germany planted a total 859,025 hectares of winter rapeseed for the 1997 harvest (777,190 ha last year) and 56,988 ha to spring rapeseed (76,435).
